dialogue_text: Excuse me—is this chair taken? I just had heart surgery, I only need a minute— Go sit on the curb.
There. Now you know where you belong. Oh, Vanessa.

Excuse me? Who said you could talk to me like that? Manager!
Mr. Beaumont. Miss Beaumont. Is there a problem? This woman was harassing my daughter, and your waitress threatened us. My daughter's wedding is here in twelve days.

Ma'am, you can walk out on your own, or I call security. Neither of you belongs on this terrace. And somebody bring me another latte.
This way, ma'am. Nobody can see you back here.

This way, ma'am. Nobody can see you back here. I'm so sorry. Nobody deserves to be treated like that. You just lost your job because of me, sweetheart. I'd rather lose it than stand there and watch her do that to you.
and watch her do that to you. What's your name? Maya. Maya Jenkins. Thank you, Maya. I won't forget what you did today.

she's in sunglasses. And the only picture she's seen of me is five years old—black hair. Now it's white.

what those people did to you. Are you doing your cardiac rehab the way the doctor wants? Not always. We still owe the clinic thirty-eight hundred.

to help set up your follow-ups. She read my discharge papers. The doctor said a little confusion on day two is normal. She looked it up and everything.

are the ones we know the least. You're overthinking it. Get some sleep.
